name: 52-idle-restart-state-loss
description: timpsd is killed while the LED is off for idle and restarts without its state: the LED is still off. The boot's silent measurement then reads noir on both sides (r = 1, not a clean night) and falls back to the audible day probe, which finds night and relights through the board script; with nobody watching the camera goes idle-dark again. Never a day verdict. led_on_in/ir_state_at 329 assert the relight; a build that leaves the LED off after the kill fails them.
